english_outline.section_1_main_conclusion: SK hynix reported record 3Q26 results. Revenue exceeded KRW 100 trillion for the first time. Operating profit reached KRW 83.3 trillion. Reuters reported the company will return about USD 75 billion to shareholders.
english_outline.section_2_core_business_changes: HBM4 shipments began in earnest. Server DDR5 sales increased significantly. 321-layer TLC eSSD sales expanded. Long-term agreements cover more than 50% of 2027-2028 capacity. Solidigm IPO review was discontinued.
english_outline.section_3_impact_on_growth_profit_cashfl: Revenue rose 32% QoQ and 328% YoY. Operating margin reached 80%. Net cash increased to KRW 98.7 trillion. The company expects HBM4 to become mainstream in 4Q26. 2027 capex will rise significantly.
english_outline.section_4_market_pricing_and_institution: Shares rose 1.92% in regular trading and 6.11% after hours. Investing.com reported the after-hours move. No named institutional ratings or target prices were provided in the sources.
english_outline.section_5_next_quarter_validation_points: 4Q26 DRAM shipments expected to rise by mid-20% range QoQ. NAND shipments expected to rise by mid-single-digit percentage. HBM4 must surpass HBM3E in shipment volume and revenue. 321-layer process must exceed half of domestic NAND capacity.

reader_questions: 公司官方披露的股东回报总额约100万亿韩元，与路透社标题所称的“750亿美元”是否指向同一口径？若不同，差异来自哪里？
稿件称“2027年资本支出将较2026年显著增加”，但官方原文的表述是“investment is expected to increase significantly”，并未限定为资本支出，这一改动是否改变了预期含义？
稿件把净现金98.7万亿韩元、借款降至15.8万亿韩元列为现金流改善的证据，但净现金是存量指标，能否直接支撑“现金流改善”的结论？
checks: 核对官方新闻稿：2026财年股东回报总额约为100万亿韩元，由300亿韩元以上的现金股息与600亿韩元以上的回购注销构成（含8月宣布的400亿韩元）。路透社标题的“750亿美元”为媒体换算口径，与官方韩元口径并非同一表述，稿件应统一使用官方数字并说明媒体换算。
核对官方新闻稿：原文为“investment is expected to increase significantly”，语境是Yongin一期全面投产、国内外基础设施投资提速，并未使用“capital spending”或“capex”。稿件改写为“资本支出”属于口径收窄，应回改为“投资”。
核对官方新闻稿：现金及现金等价物114.5万亿韩元、借款15.8万亿韩元、净现金98.7万亿韩元均为资产负债表存量数据，官方未提供经营现金流或自由现金流金额。稿件将其表述为“现金流方面”的证据不成立，应改为“资产负债表结构”并删除现金流改善的暗示。
